## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
* All styling lives in `style.css` only. Forbidden: `style="..."` attributes, `<style>` blocks, and presentational attributes in HTML.
* Target everything via class/ID selectors. HTML stays semantic and style-agnostic — a full re-theme must be achievable by editing `style.css` alone.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens (store ALL of these in `:root`)**
* Colors: `--primary: #c07030` (burnt orange), `--secondary: #7a4e24` (wood), `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`.
* Dark mode (canonical): `--bg-primary: #232e26`, `--bg-secondary: #2e3d30`, `--text-primary: #f0e8d2`, `--text-secondary: rgba(240,232,210,0.72)`, `--border-default: rgba(192,112,48,0.3)`.
* Light mode (via `html.light`): `--bg-primary: #ede6d0`, `--bg-secondary: #fefefe`, `--text-primary: #232e26`, `--text-secondary: rgba(35,46,38,0.72)`, `--border-default: rgba(122,78,36,0.35)`. Never use `#ffffff`; the only near-white allowed is `#fefefe`.
* Never-swapping brand tokens (used by Hero, Final CTA, Footer in both themes): `--bg-deep: #232e26`, `--text-on-deep: #f0e8d2`.
* Card inversion tokens: `--card-bg` / `--card-text` — dark mode: bone `#f0e8d2` cards with `#232e26` text; light mode: dark sage `#232e26` cards with bone text. This preserves the signature paper-on-sage / sage-on-paper rhythm.
* Accessibility-driven accent derivatives (mandatory, since `#c07030` cannot carry small text on either canvas): `--accent-strong: #9a4f1c` (filled buttons/badges; ≈4.9:1 with bone text), `--accent-bright: #d98e4a` (small accent text on dark sage only, ≈5.3:1), `--secondary` wood for small accent text on bone surfaces (≈5.9:1). Pure `#c07030` is reserved for rules, borders, icon chips, and display text ≥24px (3:1 large-text rule).
* Suggested state colors (verify ≥4.5:1 in both modes): dark `--text-success: #a8bf7a`, `--text-error: #e58a70`; light `--text-success: #55652e`, `--text-error: #b3402a`. Matching `--border-success` / `--border-error` tokens required.
* Geometry, depth, motion, stacking: `--radius-sm: 6px`, `--radius-md: 14px`, `--radius-lg: 24px`, `--shadow-sm: 0 2px 6px rgba(20,28,22,0.28)`, `--shadow-md: 0 12px 28px rgba(20,28,22,0.34)` (warm-tinted shadows), `--spacing-gap: 1rem`, `--transition-fast: 200ms`, `--transition-normal: 250ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)`, `--z-dropdown: 100`, `--z-modal: 1000`, `--z-toast: 1100` (define all, even if unused).
* Contrast pairing law: every light background token pairs with a dark text token and vice versa — enforce in both themes, for every token set.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support ("Full dark / Partial light")**
* Dark sage is the canonical default: `:root` holds dark tokens. Light mode is a partial theme: content sections, header, and cards swap to bone paper, while Hero, Final CTA, and Footer intentionally keep the dark sage `--bg-deep` canvas in both themes.
* Implement switching via the `.light`/`.dark` classes on `<html>` plus a `@media (prefers-color-scheme: light)` fallback scoped to `html:not(.light):not(.dark)` so the correct theme applies even before/without JS (no wrong-theme flash). Set `color-scheme: dark` / `light` accordingly.
* Visible toggle in the header (44×44 `.icon-btn`, Material Symbols `dark_mode`/`light_mode`): `aria-pressed` reflects dark state, `aria-label` updates ("Switch to light theme"/"Switch to dark theme"), choice persists in `localStorage` (key `mat-theme`), falls back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit. Theme swap animates background/text colors over 200ms.
* No HTML restructuring may be needed to switch themes — tokens only.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
* Build every layout structure with Flexbox. Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless a CSS comment documents a justified exception.
* Mobile-first: single column base; breakpoints at `min-width: 640px` and `1024px` promote grids to 3 columns via flex-wrap + flex-basis. No horizontal scrolling at any width down to 320px (decorative elements must be clipped inside their section).
* Anchor links get `scroll-margin-top: 5rem`; enable `scroll-behavior: smooth` only inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`.

**1.5 Styling Approach — Single Flat Class Vocabulary (No Framework)**
* Hand-authored vanilla CSS in `style.css` (the source spec supplies plain CSS technical direction — no CSS framework, no build step; Google Fonts/Icons CDN links are the only external references).
* One consistent kebab-case component vocabulary, never mixed with any other convention: `.container`, `.section`, `.section--alt`, `.section-rule`, `.eyebrow`, `.lead`, `.visually-hidden`, `.grid-3`, `.stack`, `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-outline`, `.btn-danger`, `.btn-lg`, `.icon-btn`, `.card`, `.card-featured`, `.card-skeleton`, `.card-empty`, `.badge`, `.input-group`, `.field-error`, plus section-scoped prefixes (`.hero-`, `.features-`, `.steps-`, `.testimonials-`, `.pricing-`, `.faq-`, `.cta-`, `.footer-`, `.nav-`).

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
* Load via `<link>` with `preconnect`: **Jost** (400;500;600;700) as `--font-base`, and **Bricolage Grotesque** (600;700;800) as `--font-display`. Bricolage Grotesque is reserved for the Hero headline and Final CTA headline; section `<h2>`s use Jost 700; eyebrows use Jost 600, uppercase, letter-spaced.
* Icons: Google Material Symbols (Rounded) via `<link>`; size icons explicitly to avoid layout shift. Forbidden: raw inline SVGs, local icon files, emoji as icons, any other icon set. Decorative icons get `aria-hidden="true"`; meaningful icons get visually-hidden text.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Button Component (all states via CSS classes)**
* Default: `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum 44×44px touch target, `--radius-sm`.
* `.btn-primary`: background `--accent-strong`, text bone (AA-safe). `.btn-outline`: transparent bg, 1.5px border + text in the section's `--text-primary`. `.btn-danger` must be defined and visually distinct in both themes (error-red on sage in dark, terracotta on bone in light) even though this page uses none.
* Hover: `brightness(1.08)` plus `--shadow-sm`, `cursor: pointer` (200ms).
* Focus: distinct `:focus-visible` ring — 2px outline in `--accent-bright` (dark surfaces) / `--secondary` (light surfaces), 2px offset, always visible.
* Active: `transform: scale(0.97)` (250ms).
* Loading (`.is-loading`): `aria-busy="true"`, pointer-events disabled to prevent double-clicks, CSS border spinner that preserves button dimensions.
* Disabled: `opacity: 0.5`, grayscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
* Success/Error feedback states: temporary styles driven by `--text-success`/`--text-error` with a Material Symbols icon swap.

**2.2 Card Component (Features, Testimonials, Pricing)**
* Default: Flexbox column, `--card-bg` background, `1px solid --border-default`, `--radius-md`, generous padding, equal heights across a row.
* Hover: `transform: translateY(-2px)` + `--shadow-md` + border alpha strengthened to 0.5 — the "subtle lift" signature.
* Focus-within: card border highlights in accent when a child link/button receives focus.
* Define `.card-skeleton` (shimmer keyframe animation) and `.card-empty` (Material Symbol + guidance text) in CSS for dynamic reuse, even though the static page doesn't render them.
* `.card-featured` (pricing): 3px solid accent top border, "Most Popular" text badge (accent-strong bg, bone text), slight elevation.

**2.3 Form & Input (Final CTA email capture)**
* Structure: `.input-group` flex column wrapping label, input, and a dedicated `.field-error` container (`aria-live="polite"`).
* States: empty (1px `--border-default`), focused (accent ring), filled, valid (success border + check icon), invalid (error border, `aria-invalid="true"`, `aria-describedby`, error icon + message text — never color alone), disabled, read-only. Minimum 44px height; placeholder text must meet AA contrast.

**2.4 Disclosure (FAQ) & Modal Contingency**
* This page requires no modals; do not add one. If any overlay were introduced, it must follow the full modal spec: animated open/close, backdrop, Material Symbol close button, focus trap, Esc + overlay-click close, loading/success/error states.
* FAQ accordion: each question is `<h3><button aria-expanded aria-controls>`; panels are `role="region"` + `aria-labelledby`; Material Symbols `expand_more` chevron rotates 180° (250ms); height animates via `grid-template-rows: 0fr→1fr`; rows separated by 1px `--border-default` with subtle hover background; fully keyboard operable; answers remain visible when JS is unavailable (JS applies the collapsed state, not the markup).

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

* **Responsive by default:** fluid `clamp()` typography and paddings; zero horizontal overflow.
* **Smooth animations:** all state changes use `--transition-fast`/`--transition-normal` with `--ease-standard` (the mandated 200–250ms window). Include a global `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block collapsing animations/transitions and smooth scroll.
* **Accessibility:** AA contrast in both modes using the pairings in 1.2; never communicate state by color alone (badges, errors, and the featured tier all carry text/icons); semantic HTML5 landmarks (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section` with `aria-labelledby`, `footer`); one `<h1>`; logical DOM/focus order; skip link as first focusable element; visible focus everywhere; `aria-live` for form feedback.
* **Mandatory visual feedback:** every interactive element responds to hover, focus, and activation — nav underline transitions, card lifts, chevron rotation, button press scale, theme toggle icon/pressed swap.
* **Destructive actions:** none on this page; `.btn-danger` remains defined per 2.1 for both themes.

## 4. DELIVERABLE & OUTPUT FORMAT

* Exactly three files: `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. A single `<script defer src="script.js">` — no inline scripts, no `<style>` blocks. `<head>` includes `lang="en"`, viewport meta, title, and meta description.
* No external image files: all visuals are CSS-drawn (gradients, borders, pseudo-elements) plus Material Symbols; avatars are initial monograms. No lorem ipsum; placeholders only for genuinely unspecified future routes (footer secondary links may use `href="#"`).
* `script.js` scope (wrapped, strict mode, no console errors): theme init/toggle/persistence with `aria-pressed` sync; mobile menu toggle with `aria-expanded` + Esc close; FAQ enhancement; CTA email validation (loading → success/error states, double-submit prevention); reduced-motion awareness via `matchMedia`. Nothing else.
* **Acceptance criteria:** keyboard-only pass works end to end; both themes pass AA; no horizontal scroll at 320px; reduced-motion disables all movement.
